#### 5. hereditary spastic paraplegia 44  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.386)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-190861)

**Proposed mechanism:** GJB6 (HGNC:4376) —DISRUPTS→ Gap Junction Assembly and Function (GO:0005924); GJC2 (HGNC:4377) —DISRUPTS→ Gap Junction Assembly and Function (GO:0005924); Gap Junction Assembly and Function (GO:0005924) —LEADS_TO→ Myelination (GO:0042554); Myelination (GO:0042554) —LEADS_TO→ Spastic paraplegia (HP:0002513); Myelination (GO:0042554) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). **How to falsify it:** The absence of functional overlap between gap junction assembly/function (GO:0005924) and myelination (GO:0042554) in cellular or animal models engineered to carry mutations in both GJB6 and GJC2 would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: The identification of common variants (AF > 0.01) in GJB6 or GJC2 associated with either disease would weaken the hypothesis.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared downstream pathway of impaired myelination due to gap junction dysfunction could lead to therapeutic strategies that target myelin repair or protection, potentially benefiting patients with both conditions.
